content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E032 (Keith Mclaughlin) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Full-time employees max write (admin requires owning role). Grant write.
- Note 2 (Security): employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Contractors with basic training max read; write requires advanced training. Grant read.

So there's a conflict between HR and Security. The notes stay in shared memory. Which do I trust? Security note says security DB shows contractor, not full-time as HR noted. The access policy differentiates contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Given contractor with basic security training, max is read. Requested write, so grant max read.

I should decide: read.

Evidence: Security note says contractor with basic security training; contractors max read without advanced training. Grant read (max). HR note claimed full-time which conflicts with security DB; security recommendation is read.

Submit decision with level read.
